skill.summary: Automatically tracks and analyzes Vish's stock and crypto portfolio using live Yahoo Finance data, providing updates, performance summaries, and rebalancing...

latestVersion.changelog: Initial release: Browser-automated stock/crypto portfolio tracking + analysis via Yahoo Finance. Supports 27 stocks/ETFs + 4 cryptos, live prices, winners/losers, rebalancing suggestions. Uses Chrome extension relay (open-claw-chrome) for real-time data fetching.
